-------------------------DEP_TBLDEPAGGRBALANCES----------------------------------
WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(numeric(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL)),0) ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL)),0) ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL)),0) PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),PREVIOUS_CURRBAL)),0) PREVIOUS_CURRBAL_tgt

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_EDS_DEP_TBLDEPAGGRBALANCES WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM

)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
, ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL_src
, ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_src
, PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL_src
, PREVIOUS_CURRBAL PREVIOUS_CURRBAL_src

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_DEP_TBLDEPAGGRBALANCES WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
, ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL_tgt
, ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_tgt
, PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL_tgt
, PREVIOUS_CURRBAL_tgt
, ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL_src
, ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_src
, PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL_src
, PREVIOUS_CURRBAL_src

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)

INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT CAST(COUNT_SRC AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_SRC
,CAST(COUNT_TGT AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_TGT
,CAST(ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL_tgt
,CAST(ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_tgt
,CAST(PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL_tgt
,CAST(PREVIOUS_CURRBAL_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) PREVIOUS_CURRBAL_tgt
,CAST(ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL_src
,CAST(ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_src
,CAST(PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL_src
,CAST(PREVIOUS_CURRBAL_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) PREVIOUS_CURRBAL_src
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,[DATE]
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
, ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL_src
, ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_src
, PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL_src
, PREVIOUS_CURRBAL_src
 )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
, ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL_tgt
, ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_tgt
, PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL_tgt
, PREVIOUS_CURRBAL_tgt
 )
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
